about_the_game:
Wet One, steady thy breath and venture forth...

In this RPG you are Rib, the frog, and it is up to you to travel through corrupt lands and waters that man has laid to waste. On your journey you will crash through castles, delve through dungeons, cleanse corruption, discover secrets, complete numerous challenges, solve puzzles, and recruit allies by sending them back to camp.

Prepare to Croak - Substantial boss fights may hold you back if you become dry.

Stay Sharp - From your blades to your staff, you have the power.

Your Equipment will vary through your adventure and new items will aid your struggles.

The world is full of magic and herb, utilize them to uncover hidden techniques and uncharted locations. Herbs will serve as your elemental catalyst.

Return to Confluence Camp to prepare for your next venture.

Your choices cause ripples - The path is up to you.

When all is lost and you've all but Croaked, remember the water and feel of the flow.

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy Violence with smoking of a wooden gandalf-esque pipe.
